17GoKart - Streamers: 
Endless mode 
1.Activate the 17GoKart game and press "Start" to start a new round. 
2.Each car starts with 6HP. The car gets faster as the game goes on. 
Dodge upcoming obstacles by swiping left or right. 
3.You'll get points for passing obstacles. Viewers can also help you by sending gifts. 
4.Hitting an obstacle will cause HP damage. If your HP reaches 0, that's the end of the road. The system will calculate your final score. 
5.If the round is over with gifts remaining, the system will add bonuses to your final score. 
(Calculation equation: Total remaining gift valuedestroy gift value* obstacle score*section weight). 
6.You can check the 17GoKart score leaderboard from the main page. Top players can win ranking prizes. 

Time Attack mode 
1. Tap "Time Attack" at the top of the main screen to switch, then press the start button. 
2. Aim for the highest score within a set time! All other rules are the same as in Endless Mode. 
3. Check the Time Attack leaderboard on the main page; during events, rewards can be earned based on your ranking! 
4. If the connection becomes unstable and needs to be reestablished, there may be a few seconds of countdown discrepancy. Please ensure a stable connection status.

17GoKart - Streamers: 
Endless mode 
1.Activate the 17GoKart game and press "Start" to start a new round. 
2.Each car starts with 6HP. The car gets faster as the game goes on. 
Dodge upcoming obstacles by swiping left or right. 
3.You'll get points for passing obstacles. Viewers can also help you by sending gifts. 
4.Hitting an obstacle will cause HP damage. If your HP reaches 0, that's the end of the road. The system will calculate your final score. 
5.If the round is over with gifts remaining, the system will add bonuses to your final score. 
(Calculation equation: Total remaining gift valuedestroy gift value* obstacle score*section weight). 
6.You can check the 17GoKart score leaderboard from the main page. Top players can win ranking prizes. 

Time Attack mode 
1. Tap "Time Attack" at the top of the main screen to switch, then press the start button. 
2. Aim for the highest score within a set time! All other rules are the same as in Endless Mode. 
3. Check the Time Attack leaderboard on the main page; during events, rewards can be earned based on your ranking! 
4. If the connection becomes unstable and needs to be reestablished, there may be a few seconds of countdown discrepancy. Please ensure a stable connection status.
